subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session initialization own permanent self-heal while Discord retains this bounded transport retry as defense in depth?
rationale: Both open PRs recover the same named conflict at different ownership layers; the branch is correct in isolation, but repository intent is needed to choose the permanent layering and avoid competing recovery policies.

options.title: Layer Both Recoveries
options.body: Keep shared self-heal canonical and retain the bounded Discord retry, then validate their combined retry, abort, history, and replay semantics on an updated branch.

options.title: Use Shared Recovery Only
options.body: Land the shared-session fix first and pause or close this PR if refreshed Discord proof shows the conflict no longer escapes to the transport layer.

recommendation.title: Layer Both Recoveries
recommendation.body: Keep shared self-heal canonical and retain the bounded Discord retry, then validate their combined retry, abort, history, and replay semantics on an updated branch.
